name: DayTimeline
label: Day timeline
description: Hours within one day: a row per person or resource and a bar from each start to its end, on an axis of hours.

props.name: startHour
props.description: The first hour the axis shows, 0 to 23. Defaults to 6.

props.name: endHour
props.description: The hour the axis ends at, 1 to 24. Defaults to 22.

props.name: now
props.description: A line at this time (`HH:MM`), such as the time now.

props.name: label
props.description: The timeline's name, read before its rows ("Shifts, Tuesday 4 March").

props.name: rowHeader
props.description: The header of the label column. Defaults to "Name".

props.name: onBarClick
props.description: Called with the bar and its row when a bar is pressed; bars are buttons only when it is set.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the times are written in, such as `de-DE`. Defaults to `en-US`. This component can render from a Server Component, so it takes the prop alone and reads no LocaleProvider.

DayTimelineBar.description: One stretch of time on a row: a shift, a booking, a meeting.

DayTimelineColor.description: The accents a bar can take, the core accent roles the calendar's events use.

DayTimelineRow.description: One row of the timeline: a person, a room, a machine.

alternatives.name: GanttChart
alternatives.when: the bars run over days and months rather than hours within one day
